A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 16-page LDRLD paper, including five pages of supplementary material. Pages 2–16 are pixel-identical; page 1 differs only in the marginal arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original LDRLD experiments on image classification, person re-identification and object detection, plus ablation and robustness results in the supplementary material.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original experimental results, including the main benchmark comparisons and supplementary ablation, robustness and detection experiments.

M1.justification: The recursive logit-pair construction, ADW with IRW and ERD, knowledge-integrity and remaining-non-target losses, and supplementary Algorithm 1 are identical.

E1.justification: Both cover CIFAR-100, ImageNet-1K, Tiny-ImageNet and CUB200 classification, Market-1501 person re-identification, and MS-COCO2017 detection. Test scenarios, including noisy-label experiments, are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in every corresponding experiment, including KD, DKD, WTTM and TeKAP where evaluated. No comparison method is added, removed or revised.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, preprocessing, metrics, teacher-student configurations, training schedules and testing procedures are unchanged throughout the main paper and supplement.

E4.justification: Both retain identical recursion-depth and loss ablations, hyperparameter sensitivity, noisy-label tests, teacher-capacity comparisons, KD combinations and visual analyses.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains the statement that tables report averages of three runs. Run-count disclosures and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical scores and qualitative findings match, including main Tables 1–6 and supplementary Tables 11–23. No result entries are added, removed or corrected.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and formulations in Section 3, including recursive combinations, weighting functions and Equations 1–21, are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about fine-grained logit transfer, adaptive pair weighting and performance across datasets.

C2.justification: Both retain the same mechanism explanations, qualification concerning performance against WTTM on ImageNet, and limitation requiring manual selection of recursion depth d.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameter tables, hardware and timing information are identical. The abstract's promise to make code publicly available is also unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the reference list and the positioning relative to feature-based and logit-based distillation methods are identical.

P1.justification: Only the marginal arXiv stamp changes from v1 dated 21 July 2025 to v2 dated 10 February 2026. The paper's prose, headings and organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–5, Tables 1–23, captions, formatting and placement are identical. The stamp text update does not alter the document layout.

improvement.justification: The complete scientific content, evidence, reproducibility information and presentation are unchanged, including the supplement. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp provides no meaningful improvement or deterioration in paper quality.
